request.subject: PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Turn it into a stone-age log submarine: remove the mast, the sail and the feathers; the canoe becomes one closed long tree-trunk log of the same tawny wood with dark bark and a flat sawn end; keep the blue orange-striped plesiosaur head at the bow end; on top a small hatch covered with sandy hide with dark brown spots and a tall bone-white reed. No legs, no flippers: a log boat. Keep the size, thick black outline and art style the same, on a transparent background.
